cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you approve keeping Tuesday's rain in this cup for the wedding? I trained you to plan ahead when you took over the venue; don't stop at booking chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Catch it before it learns to fall. You always waited until a problem knew what it was doing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if it leaks onto Wednesday's wedding?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're thinking two bookings ahead. We'll seal it with Thursday's drought. Sign for both dry lawns; you can initial the weather in advance.
